title_zh: 因引语授权未明而推迟通讯发布

scenario.label_zh: 暂停未获引语授权的通讯发布
scenario.goal_zh: 识别匿名引语仍可能暴露身份的风险，约定先取得本人同意再发布并暂缓宣传

context_zh: 社区通讯编辑在发布前核对一段受访者引语的许可。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Sol
sentences.text: Is the newsletter ready for publication? The publicity team wants a link this afternoon.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: There's one problem. We haven't confirmed whether Ruth agreed to have her story included.

sentences.speaker: Sol
sentences.text: Could we just remove her surname?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: The details could still identify her. Publishing it now could pose a problem for her at work.

sentences.speaker: Sol
sentences.text: Then I propose we hold the issue and ask her to approve the exact passage.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll send her the passage, and you can tell the team not to promote the issue yet.

sentences.speaker: Sol
sentences.text: I'll do that. We won't publish it until we've resolved this.
